concept_options.title: From Workhouse to Standing Ovation
concept_options.hook: At seven he was in a London workhouse. At 82, Hollywood stood for twelve minutes.
concept_options.visual_approach: One continuous low-poly black-and-white miniature world; camera travels London street → workhouse → racetrack → studio lot → microphone → ocean liner → Oscar stage; intertitle cards; bowler hat and cane stand in for Chaplin
concept_options.why_this_works: Strongest contrast in the research, and a journey suits a moving 3D camera

concept_options.title: The Man Who Refused to Talk
concept_options.hook: Hollywood learned to talk in 1927. Chaplin kept quiet for 13 more years.
concept_options.visual_approach: Silent film set with an ignored dangling microphone
concept_options.why_this_works: Silent-into-sound fact fits a silent video

concept_options.title: Banished by the Country He Made Laugh
concept_options.hook: He sailed for London in 1952, and America locked the door behind him.
concept_options.visual_approach: Ocean liner and 20-year exile, ending at the 1972 return

music_source.mood_direction: silent; optional Lyria silent-era piano later

stages.approach: Camera beats in one continuous coordinate system
